parameters.name: base_t
parameters.comment: slab top above the glue plane z = 0

parameters.name: cs_l
parameters.comment: bottom coverslip length X - must cover every channel and via

parameters.name: cs_recess
parameters.comment: depth of the glue band under the chip (coverslip + adhesive flush)

parameters.name: cs_gap
parameters.comment: clearance at each end of the glue band

parameters.name: ch_floor
parameters.comment: channel floor above z = 0: 0 = open groove sealed by the coverslip

parameters.name: via_d
parameters.comment: vertical via from the channel into a port

parameters.name: well_d
parameters.comment: chamber well diameter (leaf space; the O-ring seals on this bore)

parameters.name: chamber_h
parameters.comment: chamber height: coverslip to window glass (leaf + liquid)

parameters.name: stub_len
parameters.comment: plug stub below the stop face (window recess, wall, O-ring groove, wall)

parameters.name: ledge_z
parameters.comment: top of the well = stop face of the plug

parameters.name: well_chamfer
parameters.comment: O-ring lead-in chamfer at the top of the well

parameters.name: th_len
parameters.comment: threaded length of the boss above the stop face

parameters.name: th_clear
parameters.comment: printing clearance of the chip's threaded bore, radial per side

parameters.name: plug_th_clear
parameters.comment: printing clearance of the plug thread, radial per side (plug only: loosen by reprinting the plug)

parameters.name: th_chamfer
parameters.comment: lead-in chamfer at the top of the threaded bore

parameters.name: th_start
parameters.comment: gap between the stop face and the first internal thread groove

parameters.name: head_gap
parameters.comment: head to boss top when the plug sits on the stop face

parameters.name: oring_id
parameters.comment: O-ring inner diameter (CAD-new ISO 3601-1 12 x 1.5 NBR70)

parameters.name: groove_root_d
parameters.comment: O-ring groove root diameter on the stub

parameters.name: groove_top_gap
parameters.comment: O-ring groove top below the stop face

parameters.name: plug_window
parameters.comment: 1 = glass window glued into the stub + aperture; 0 = solid plug (blocks transmitted light unless printed clear)

parameters.name: win_d
parameters.comment: window (plug_window = 1): round coverslip glued into the stub

parameters.name: win_fit
parameters.comment: diametral clearance of the window recess

parameters.name: in_x
parameters.comment: inlet luer axis, distance from the chamber centre (+X)

parameters.name: out_x
parameters.comment: outlet axis (reservoir or luer), distance from the centre (-X)

parameters.name: luer_hub_d
parameters.comment: hub diameter at the base of the lugs (ISO 6.73)

parameters.name: luer_taper_deg
parameters.comment: half angle of the 6 % taper, atan(0.03)

parameters.name: luer_free
parameters.comment: hub length below the face kept slim for the male collar (ISO >= 5.5)

parameters.name: luer_foot_d
parameters.comment: foot diameter under the slim hub

parameters.name: luer_lead
parameters.comment: lead of the double-start lug thread (pitch 2.5, right-hand)

parameters.name: luer_lug_rev
parameters.comment: turns per lug (2 lugs at 180 deg)

parameters.name: luer_lug_base
parameters.comment: lug width at the hub (ISO max 1.2)

parameters.name: luer_lug_crest
parameters.comment: lug width at the crest (ISO min 0.3)

parameters.name: luer_lug_gap
parameters.comment: lug top below the luer face

parameters.name: relief_d
parameters.comment: plug thread relief above the stop face

parameters.name: ti_w_root
parameters.comment: internal groove width at its root

parameters.name: ti_r_in
parameters.comment: internal groove profile inner edge (inside the bore)

parameters.name: te_w_root
parameters.comment: external groove width at its root

parameters.name: te_height
parameters.comment: external thread coil height (runs out into the head)

parameters.name: lug_r_in
parameters.comment: lug profile inner edge (inside the hub)

parameters.name: lug_zc
parameters.comment: lug profile centre at the coil start
